notes: Cases 1-8 exercise the skill's own rules; cases 9-10 are anti-trigger and boundary cases where applying the full Iron Law would be wrong. Prompts are in Russian because that is the user's working language; expectations are in English to match the skill text.

evals.name: plan-before-first-test
evals.prompt: Давай сделаем по TDD: нужна функция расчета скидки для корзины. Правила скидок обсудим по ходу.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks only for missing behavior and interface choices that materially affect the first test. Once resolved, it starts the first red-green cycle without a separate approval gate.
expectations: Agent asks only about the missing interface or priority details needed for the first test
Agent frames what it needs as behaviors to test, not as implementation steps
Agent does not ask for a blanket approval of a test list
No production code is written before the first failing test

evals.name: tracer-bullet-then-increment
evals.prompt: Интерфейс согласован: calculate_discount(cart, promo) -> Discount. Поведения по приоритету: 1) промокод на 10 процентов, 2) истекший промокод игнорируется, 3) скидка не превышает суммы корзины. Поехали по TDD.
evals.expected_output: One test, then the minimal implementation for it, then the next test. Each RED is run and observed before GREEN.
expectations: Agent writes exactly one failing test first, for the first behavior only
Agent runs the test and reports the failure before writing implementation
Implementation added for behavior 1 is minimal and does not handle behaviors 2 or 3
Agent runs the test again after implementing and confirms it passes
Only after the first cycle completes does the agent write the test for behavior 2

evals.name: reject-horizontal-slicing
evals.prompt: Напиши сразу все пять тестов на парсер конфига, а потом реализацию под них - так быстрее, чем бегать туда-сюда.
evals.expected_output: The agent names this as horizontal slicing, explains why bulk tests verify imagined behavior, and proposes vertical slices instead.
expectations: Agent declines to write all five tests before any implementation
Agent names the problem as horizontal slicing or bulk-written tests
Agent explains that bulk tests verify imagined rather than actual behavior
Agent proposes one test, one implementation, repeated per behavior
Agent proposes a single tracer-bullet test as the immediate next step, or asks only for the interface it needs to write that one test

evals.name: iron-law-code-written-first
evals.prompt: Я уже написал клиент с ретраями, вот он. Добавь к нему тесты, чтобы закрыть поведение ретраев.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the supplied code, identifies tests for it as characterization rather than TDD, and uses a failing test before making any new behavior change.
expectations: Agent preserves the supplied implementation and does not propose deletion
Agent names tests that pass against the supplied code as characterization tests
Agent checks whether the user requested only tests or a behavior change
Agent does not claim a red-green cycle for behavior implemented before this task
Agent writes a failing test first if the task includes new behavior

evals.name: verify-red-is-mandatory
evals.prompt: Тест на пустой email готов, он точно упадет - можешь сразу писать валидацию, не гоняй прогон.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the test anyway and confirms both that it fails and that it fails for the expected reason.
expectations: Agent runs the test before writing implementation
Agent states that verifying RED is mandatory and cannot be assumed
Agent checks that the test fails rather than errors
Agent checks that the failure reason is the missing feature, not a typo or import error

evals.name: green-minimal-no-speculation
evals.prompt: Тест 'retries failed operations 3 times' падает как надо. Пиши реализацию, и сразу заложи настраиваемое число попыток, exponential backoff и хук on_retry - потом пригодится.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes only what the current failing test requires and defers the extra options to their own tests.
expectations: Implementation passes the current test and adds no configuration options
Agent declines to add backoff strategy or on_retry hook at this step
Agent explains that unrequested features are speculative until a test demands them
Agent offers to add each extra capability through its own red-green cycle

evals.name: bugfix-starts-with-failing-test
evals.prompt: Баг в проде: submit_form принимает пустой email. Почини, там правка на одну строчку.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes a test that reproduces the bug, watches it fail, then fixes it.
expectations: Agent writes a failing test reproducing the empty-email bug before touching the implementation
Agent runs the test and confirms it reproduces the reported behavior
Fix is applied only after the reproducing test fails
Agent re-runs the test to confirm it passes
Agent does not accept 'one-line fix' as a reason to skip the test

evals.name: mocking-at-boundaries-only
evals.prompt: Вот текущий тест чекаута. Расширь его: добавь проверку, что при недоступной корзине платеж не вызывается.
evals.expected_output: The agent points out that the existing test mocks internal collaborators and asserts on mock calls, and rewrites toward behavior through the public interface, mocking only the external payment boundary.
expectations: Agent classifies each injected dependency as a system boundary or an internal collaborator, or asks for the sources needed to classify them, instead of mocking all of them by default
Agent identifies assertions on call counts and call arguments as implementation-detail testing
Agent keeps or allows a mock only at the external payment boundary
New test asserts on the observable checkout result rather than on mock interactions
Agent references the mocking or testing-anti-patterns guidance rather than inventing its own rule
Agent audits the existing test file before extending it, instead of copying its mocking style into the new test

evals.name: anti-trigger-characterization-tests
evals.prompt: Поведение менять не надо. Нужно просто покрыть тестами существующий модуль отчетов, он давно без тестов, а мы собираемся его рефакторить.
evals.expected_output: The agent adds tests for the existing code without demanding that working production code be deleted; the Iron Law applies to new production code, not to characterizing code that already ships.
expectations: Agent does not demand deleting the existing module
Agent writes tests that capture current observable behavior through the public interface
Agent notes that these tests are the safety net for the upcoming refactor
Agent applies TDD to any new behavior that appears during the refactor

evals.name: prototype-outside-tdd
evals.prompt: Накидай одноразовый скрипт, чтобы просто посмотреть, как выглядит ответ нового API. Выкину сразу после.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the explicitly requested throwaway exploration as outside this TDD workflow and proceeds within the user's authorization.
expectations: Agent recognizes a throwaway prototype as outside this workflow
Agent does not ask for separate approval to skip TDD
Agent does not claim that exploratory code had a red-green cycle
Agent does not write a full test suite for the throwaway script without being asked

evals.name: known-contract-starts-without-approval
evals.prompt: Добавь тест и исправь баг: calculate_total({items: []}) возвращает None вместо 0. Сигнатуру не меняй. Сделай по TDD.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the specified contract to write and run one failing regression test, fixes the bug, and reruns it without asking for approval of a test list.
expectations: Agent writes a regression test for an empty item list returning 0
Agent runs the test and checks the expected failure before implementation
Agent does not ask for approval of an already-specified behavior or interface
Agent preserves unrelated code and existing user changes

evals.name: exploration-preserves-worktree
evals.prompt: Я разрешил сначала разведать интеграцию. Ты уже написал рабочий черновик адаптера в текущем worktree, тестов пока нет. Продолжай по TDD, не теряя полученный код и мои параллельные правки.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the exploratory code and user changes, labels tests for implemented behavior as characterization, and applies RED to the next missing behavior.
expectations: Agent does not delete or overwrite the exploratory adapter
Agent does not discard unrelated worktree changes
Agent does not claim a red-green cycle for behavior already present
Agent identifies the next missing behavior and runs its failing test before implementing it
